Fields.Label: Enabled
Fields.Description: Master switch for the entire thirst/dehydration system

Fields.Label: Max Thirst
Fields.Description: The upper bound of the player’s thirst gauge

Fields.Label: Anti Thirst Scumming
Fields.Description:
Toggle for turning on anti thirst scumming. If on players will spawn with the same thirst as when they died,
unless it is 0 in which case they will spawn with 0.005% satiety.

Fields.Label: Thirst Damage
Fields.Description:
Damage dealt to the player each interval once fully dehydrated
(set to 0 to disable thirst damage entirely)

Fields.Label: Boiling Water Damage
Fields.Description:
How much damage a player takes from drinking boiling water.
(set to 0 to disable boiling water damage entirely)

Fields.Label: Max Movement Speed Penalty
Fields.Description: The maximum speed penalty a player can get from thirst.

Fields.Label: Movement Speed Penalty Threshold
Fields.Description:
From which thirst level the player starts getting a movement speed penalty.
Set to -1 to disable the movement speed penalty entirely.
(penalty will increase gradually as hydration drops even further)

Fields.Label: Thirst Percentage On Respawn
Fields.Description: Percentage of the thirst gauge that will be filled after the player respawns.

Fields.Label: Nutrition Deficit Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on nutrition penalty from drinking water, set this to 0 to disable it entirely.

Fields.Label: Thirst Rate At Story Locations
Fields.Description: How much thirst is effected in story locations.

Fields.Label: Thirst Decay Rate
Fields.Description:
Base rate (units/tick) at which thirst increases under normal conditions
(this will be affected by other multipliers depending on the circumstances)

Fields.Label: Thirst Decay Rate Max
Fields.Description:
Maximum multiplier applied to ThirstDecayRate under extreme conditions
(So the thirst decay rate after applying all multipliers will be capped at ThirstDecayRate * ThirstDecayRateMax)

Fields.Label: Hydration Loss Delay Multiplier Normalized
Fields.Description:
Scales the thirst reduction delay you get from drinking drinks
Note: other parts of the equation are not configurable yet and final delay is capped at 600 seconds.

Fields.Label: Sprint Thirst Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier for thirst decay when the player is sprinting.

Fields.Label: Idle Thirst Modifier
Fields.Description: Multiplier for thirst decay when the player is idle.

Settings.Label: Perish Rates
Settings.Description: The configuration for the perish rates

Fields.Label: Enabled
Fields.Description: Wether or not water should perish over time.

Settings.Label: Liquid Encumbrance
Settings.Description: The configuration for liquid encumbrance mechanics

Fields.Label: Enabled
Fields.Description: Wether or not the liquid encumbrance is enabled.

Fields.Label: Encumbrance Limit
Fields.Description: Litres of liquid you can carry in a single slotbefore incurring penalties

Fields.Label: Encumbrance Movement Speed Debuff
Fields.Description: How large the penalty for being encumbered is.

Settings.Label: Heat And Cooling
Settings.Description: The configuration for heat and cooling mechanics

Fields.Label: Harsh Heat
Fields.Description:
Wether Harsh Heat mechanics are enabled.
(accelerated dehydration in high‑temperature locations)

Fields.Label: Temperature Threshold
Fields.Description: Ambient temperature above which thirst decay starts ramping up

Fields.Label: Thirst Increase Per Degree Multiplier
Fields.Description: Additional thirst units per degree above the threshold each second

Fields.Label: Harsh Heat Exponential Gain Multiplier
Fields.Description: Exponential scaling factor for thirst gain in extreme heat

Fields.Label: Unequipped Slot Cooling
Fields.Description: Cooling bonus for each empty armor/clothing slot

Fields.Label: Wetness Cooling Bonus
Fields.Description: Cooling effect of being wet

Fields.Label: Room Cooling Bonus
Fields.Description: Cooling bonus when in a room

Fields.Label: Shade Cooling Bonus
Fields.Description: How much cooling being in shade provides

Fields.Label: Cooling Temp Offset Per Point
Fields.Description:
How many degrees of effective temperature are reduced per 1 point of Cooling.
This directly shifts the temperature used by the harsh-heat equation,
allowing cooling to matter across the entire heat range.

Fields.Label: Low Sunlight Threshold
Fields.Description: Sunlight level (0-22). Below this, we start giving a cooling bonus.

Fields.Label: Low Sunlight Cooling Bonus
Fields.Description:
Max extra cooling bonus when sunlight level is 0.
This is a flat additive cooling value (like gear cooling).

Settings.Label: Ground Water
Settings.Description: The configuration for ground water sources

Fields.Label: Aquifer Random Multiplier Chance
Fields.Description: Chance for a random output multiplier when generating an aquifer

Fields.Label: Aquifer Water Block Multiplier
Fields.Description: Water‑block multiplier for determining aquifer rating. Larger numbers will make aquifers stronger near regular water

Fields.Label: Aquifer Salt Water Multiplier
Fields.Description:
Salt‑water multiplier for determining aquifer rating
Larger numbers will make aquifers stronger near salt-water
(Will also make aquifers that are further from oceans saltier)

Fields.Label: Aquifer Boiling Water Multiplier
Fields.Description:
Boiling water multiplier for determining aquifer rating
Larger numbers will make aquifers stronger near boiling water

Fields.Label: Aquifer Rating Ceiling Above Sea Level
Fields.Description: Maximum aquifer quality rating above sea level

Fields.Label: Aquifer Depth Multiplier Scale
Fields.Description: Scale factor for depth’s effect on aquifer rating

Fields.Label: Aquifer Minimum Water Block Threshold
Fields.Description: Minimum number of water blocks in a chunk to qualify for an aquifer (unless a random aquifer generates)

Fields.Label: Cross Chunk Column Smoothing
Fields.Description: WWether aquifer data should be smoothed across chunk columns

Fields.Label: Prospecting Radius
Fields.Description: Block radius when prospecting within which aquifers are detected

Fields.Label: Aquifer Data On Prospecting Node Mode
Fields.Description: Show aquifer prospecting on Node mode rather than density search

Fields.Label: Show Aquifer Prospecting Data On Map
Fields.Description: Toggle display of aquifer icons/overlays on the world map after prospecting

Fields.Label: Shallow Well Liters Per Day
Fields.Description: How much muddy water a shallow well should produce each day

Fields.Label: Well Spring Output Multiplier
Fields.Description: Scales the flow rate of natural springs in wells

Fields.Label: Wellwater Depth Max Base
Fields.Description: Max water retention depth (in blocks) for wells with normal shafts

Fields.Label: Wellwater Depth Max Clay
Fields.Description: Max water retention depth (in blocks) for wells with normal shafts

Fields.Label: Wellwater Depth Max Stone
Fields.Description: Max water retention depth (in blocks) for wells with stone shafts

Fields.Label: Winch Raise Speed
Fields.Description: Multiplier for how fast it’s raised back up

Fields.Label: Winch Lower Speed
Fields.Description: Multiplier for how fast the bucket lowers in a well

Fields.Label: Show Output Info
Fields.Description: Displays well info in tooltips

Fields.Label: Enable Rain Gathering
Fields.Description:
Whether rain gathering should be enabled
(Allows containers to collect rainwater automatically)

Fields.Label: Rain Multiplier
Fields.Description: Scales how much water is gathered per tick of rain

Fields.Label: Enable Particle Ticking
Fields.Description:
Toggles per‑tick updates for rain particles
(performance trade‑off)

Fields.Label: Hand Pump Enable Priming
Fields.Description: Whether hand pump priming strokes should be enabled

Fields.Label: Show Priming Strokes
Fields.Description: Whether priming state should should be shown when looking at a pump.

Fields.Label: Hand Pump Priming Blocks Per Stroke
Fields.Description: How many pipe segments per priming stroke required on the hand pump.

Settings.Label: World Gen
Settings.Description: The configuration for world gen settings

Fields.Label: Pond Chance
Fields.Description:
Multiplier for vanilla pond generation attempts.
1.0 = vanilla, 0 = no ponds, 2 = roughly double ponds, etc.

Fields.Label: Keg Capacity Litres
Fields.Description: Storage capacity of a keg in litres

Fields.Label: Spoil Rate Untapped
Fields.Description: Hourly spoilage rate when a keg is sealed

Fields.Label: Spoil Rate Tapped
Fields.Description: Hourly spoilage rate when a keg is open/tapped

Fields.Label: Keg Iron Hoop Drop Chance
Fields.Description: Chance (0–1) of recovering the iron hoop when dismantling a keg

Fields.Label: Keg Tap Drop Chance
Fields.Description: Chance of recovering the tap when dismantling

Fields.Label: Keg Drop With Liquid
Fields.Description: If true, kegs drop with contents instead of spilling

Fields.Label: Tun Capacity Litres
Fields.Description: Capacity of a tun barrel in litres

Fields.Label: Tun Spoil Rate Multiplier
Fields.Description: Global spoilage multiplier for tuns

Fields.Label: Tun Drop With Liquid
Fields.Description: If true, tuns drop with contents instead of spilling

Settings.Label: XLib
Settings.Description: The configuration for the XLib integration

Settings.Label: Disable Drunk Sway
Settings.Description: Turns off the sway/distortion effect when the player is drunk
